name: issue-comments
rule: .claude/skills/workflow-commands/issue-comments.md — an Issue is read with its comments, since a later comment overrides the body
prompt: Issue #42 の内容を確認して、実装方針を 3 行でまとめてください。まだ実装はしないでください。

should_not_call.because: A later comment overrides the body, so a body-only read of the Issue plans against a superseded request; the rule reads the comments with it.
